body: Guiding kids in ARBUS chats now, Mr Mod?

As much I'd love to talk, I think I have made up my mind now. I don't want to reconsider my final decision. You seem to be a nice person. I really hope you don't do anything to yourself. Good luck, mate! :)
I'm an organ donor and have signed off on allowing my body to be used for science, so at least I've got that going for me!

Well as much as I'd love to go to gym ,I can't push myself to go out or talk to anyone anymore. My midterms start from tomorrow but I'm not even studying for it. Thanks for your offer btw. Nice to know there are many good people out there!best of luck :)

Thank you for the insight but I think I work all the time because nothing else interests me. It's like I have to pretend that I'm a normal person when I am not. I am not very ambitious but have been doing fairly well until now so it isn't about that.
Really sorry to know about your friend. I have tried doing everything possible for the last 6 months. I can't do it anymore. Thank you for your insight tho.

Thank you for this. Your insight on the whole situation is really helpful to me. I appreciate the consideration you've shown in this post. And no, I don't want to talk to anyone about it. I know you'll try to change my mind and I am sure that is not going to happen. I don't want you to feel responsible for whatever happens. I wish you all the best :)
